d: Platinum blonde hair, chin-length and styled with thick bangs, accompanies a golden-blonde mustache. Sharp, determined eyes of a pale blue shade set in a mature face of a grown adult. A muscular, broad-shouldered build wearing a blue tunic with gold trim, dark trousers, and a voluminous black fur mantle over the shoulders. Accessories include a brown wide-brimmed hat with a blue band, brown leather gloves with fur cuffs, a brown utility belt with a gold star buckle, and brown boots with silver spurs.
